facts.business: GCM Capital Advisors Limited is engaged in investments and trading of shares and securities and other financial activities, meeting the criteria for registration as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) under Section 45-IA of the RBI Act, 1934, though it has not obtained such registration.

segments.name: Investments and trading of shares and securities and other financial activities

auditor.name: S P M L & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Mumbai (FRN - 136549W)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: 1) Company meets NBFC criteria under Section 45-IA of RBI Act, 1934 but has not obtained registration. 2) Certain balances of trade receivables, trade payables, and loans and advances are subject to confirmation, reconciliation, and consequential adjustments. 3) Advances totaling INR 641.70 Lakhs (gross) given for acquisition of shares/securities are pending settlement as on balance sheet date. 4) Interest income not recognized on some outstanding loans and advances.

key_risks: Company operates as an NBFC without required RBI registration
Significant advances (INR 641.70 Lakhs) pending settlement for acquisition of shares/securities
Trade receivables, trade payables, and loans and advances subject to confirmation and reconciliation
Interest income not recognized on some outstanding loans and advances
Expected Credit Loss provisioning involves significant management judgment and estimation uncertainty
